mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM alert_record WHERE recognition_id = #{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM alert_appeal WHERE target_type = 'RECOGNITION' AND target_id = #{id})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recognition_record WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recognition_file_cleanup (path) VALUES (#{path}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE next_run_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM recognition_file_cleanup WHERE next_run_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_run_at, id LIMIT 25

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM recognition_record WHERE key_frame_path = #{path}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM alert_record WHERE key_frame_path = #{path}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM alert_timeline_frame WHERE key_frame_path = #{path})
mapper.update: UPDATE recognition_file_cleanup SET attempts = attempts + 1, next_run_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, LEAST(3600, 30 * (attempts + 1)), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE id = #{id}
